name: tatvic-implementation-sdk
description: Universal First-Party Analytics Proxy & Morphed GTM Loader SDK with Bot/LLM Agent Detection and PII Redaction for Web, React, Next.js, and Node

scripts.build:subpaths:esm: bun build src/react.tsx --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/react.js --external react && bun build src/next.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/next.js && bun build src/express.ts --target=browser --format=esm --outfile=dist/express.js
scripts.build:subpaths:cjs: bun build src/react.tsx --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/react.cjs --external react && bun build src/next.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/next.cjs && bun build src/express.ts --target=node --format=cjs --outfile=dist/express.cjs
scripts.build:subpaths: bun run build:subpaths:esm && bun run build:subpaths:cjs
scripts.build: bun run build:bundle && bun run build:esm && bun run build:cjs && bun run build:subpaths && bun run build:types
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run test && bun run build

author: Jimit Chavda <jimit@tatvic.com>
